cues.en: Welcome to Section five.
cues.zh: 歡迎來到第五章。

cues.en: Optimal Model Selection.
cues.zh: 最佳模型選擇。

cues.en: This is lecture 17 Threshold optimization using performance metrics.
cues.zh: 這是第十七堂課：使用效能指標來最佳化門檻。

cues.en: So if we recreate the optimal xgboost classifier again, and once we've got that trained model stored,
cues.zh: 先重新建立最佳的 XGBoost 分類器，並保存訓練好的模型。

cues.en: we have access to the predict probability method that allows us to make predictions and to return the
cues.zh: 接著可以使用 predict_proba 方法做預測，取得

cues.en: class probabilities for either the non-fraudulent class or the fraudulent class.
cues.zh: 非詐欺類別與詐欺類別各自的機率。

cues.en: Then what we can do is we can explicitly slice the probabilities for the fraudulent class only and use
cues.zh: 然後明確切出詐欺類別的機率，

cues.en: those as our predictions, which would obviously be the predictions for the probability of being fraudulent essentially.
cues.zh: 將它作為預測結果，也就是每筆交易涉及詐欺的預測機率。

cues.en: All right then.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: If we want to understand which thresholds we should set our model to, we can do that, I guess, in a number of ways.
cues.zh: 如果想知道應該替模型設定什麼門檻，可以有幾種方法。

cues.en: One of those ways is to optimize our threshold according to some metric, and those metrics would be
cues.zh: 其中之一，就是依照某個指標來最佳化門檻；這些指標可以是

cues.en: one or multiple of the performance metrics that we've covered in some of the previous lectures.
cues.zh: 前面幾堂課介紹過的一個或多個效能指標。

cues.en: So for example, area under the precision recall curve area under the ROC curve and so on.
cues.zh: 例如精確率－召回率曲線下面積，或 ROC 曲線下面積等等。

cues.en: So in this example, I've chosen the area under the precision recall curve and I can calculate that by using the Sklearn dot matrix method.
cues.zh: 在這個例子中，我選用精確率－召回率曲線下面積，並使用 sklearn.metrics 中的方法計算。

cues.en: And what I'm going to do is I'm going to initialize two lists.
cues.zh: 首先，初始化兩個串列。

cues.en: So first, a threshold list, which is going to be a list that contains all of the different thresholds that I simulate.
cues.zh: 第一個是 thresholds 串列，用來存放我們模擬的所有不同門檻。

cues.en: Then I'm going to have an area under the precision recall curve list which is going to store all of the calculated area under the precision recall curve scores that I generate.
cues.zh: 第二個是精確率－召回率曲線下面積分數串列，保存每次計算出的分數。

cues.en: Then, because this is an experiment, I'm going to use numpy to simulate a number of thresholds which
cues.zh: 因為這是一項實驗，我會用 NumPy 模擬一組門檻，

cues.en: are effectively going to maintain a linear space.
cues.zh: 讓它們在線性空間中均勻分布。

cues.en: So it'll be a set of numbers ranging from 0 to 1 and there will be 100 increments of of them.
cues.zh: 也就是從 0 到 1 的一組數值，共分成 100 個點。

cues.en: So there'll be 100 bins of equally spaced data points within this range of numbers ranging from 0 to 1.
cues.zh: 因此，在 0 到 1 的範圍內，會有 100 個等距的資料點。

cues.en: So those will be all of our theoretical thresholds.
cues.zh: 這些就是我們要測試的所有假設門檻。

cues.en: So you could think of a the initial threshold, there might be a threshold of zero, which would be
cues.zh: 最初的門檻可能是 0，也就是

cues.en: 0% and that could range up to 50%, which is typically your classification threshold defaults all the way up to 100%.
cues.zh: 0%，中間會經過通常作為預設分類門檻的 50%，一直到 100%。

cues.en: And at that threshold or at that point of the threshold, that's where your classification decision
cues.zh: 這個門檻所在的位置，就是分類決策

cues.en: boundary is placed, where if the score that you generate is above that threshold, then you would classify that transaction as fraudulent.
cues.zh: 邊界；如果模型產生的分數高於門檻，就把該交易歸為詐欺。

cues.en: And if it's below the threshold, then you would classify it as non fraudulent.
cues.zh: 如果低於門檻，就歸為非詐欺。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So once we've got these 100 thresholds simulated, we can use a for loop to iterate through each of
cues.zh: 模擬出這 100 個門檻後，就可以用 for 迴圈逐一遍歷

cues.en: the thresholds and then we can update our prediction thresholds value.
cues.zh: 每個門檻，再更新依門檻判斷後的預測值。

cues.en: So the actual classification based on the individual predictions that the model has made in relation
cues.zh: 也就是根據模型對各筆資料做出的預測，

cues.en: to the threshold that we've set.
cues.zh: 相對於我們設定的門檻，產生實際分類。

cues.en: So we've got a threshold, we've got a very low one as, as a start, and then we can use list comprehension
cues.zh: 先從很低的門檻開始，再利用串列生成式，

cues.en: to update all of the thresholds, like I've said, with this condition.
cues.zh: 依照這個條件，更新所有預測的分類值。

cues.en: So if it's greater than the threshold, then we would classify that transaction as a one.
cues.zh: 如果高於門檻，就將該交易歸為 1。

cues.en: Otherwise, if it's below the threshold, then we would classify it as a zero and that's for every element within the ground truth set.
cues.zh: 否則，如果低於門檻，就歸為 0；對資料中的每個元素都做這樣的判斷。

cues.en: So the widespread or rather what the model predicted, then we can actually take these and append the
cues.zh: 也就是針對 y_pred，或者說模型的預測結果進行處理。接著把

cues.en: thresholds themselves to a list which we can use later for plotting and visualization, etcetera.
cues.zh: 門檻本身加入串列，供後續繪圖與視覺化使用。

cues.en: Then we are going to move on and start to calculate the area under the precision recall curve score.
cues.zh: 再來就開始計算精確率－召回率曲線下面積分數。

cues.en: So what we can do there is then take those thresholds so there's updated classifications based on the
cues.zh: 取出依這個門檻所更新的分類結果，

cues.en: threshold as well as the ground truth, and we can calculate the average precision score for that scenario
cues.zh: 以及真實標籤，計算這個門檻情境下的 average_precision_score。

cues.en: of where the threshold is.
cues.zh: 也就是目前門檻的評分。

cues.en: Once we've generated that score, we can then append it to our list of scores.
cues.zh: 算出分數後，就把它加入分數串列。

cues.en: And then once that for loop ends, so after the 100 iterations, we'll exit the for loop and then we can combine the results.
cues.zh: for 迴圈完成 100 次迭代並結束後，就可以整合結果。

cues.en: So the two lists, we can combine into a data frame, we can name them and then we can go ahead and plot them, add labels, etcetera.
cues.zh: 把這兩個串列組成 DataFrame，替欄位命名，再繪圖、加上標籤等等。

cues.en: And that gives us this plot below.
cues.zh: 就能得到下面這張圖。

cues.en: So here we can see all of the different thresholds that we've simulated.
cues.zh: 這裡可以看到我們模擬的所有門檻。

cues.en: It doesn't make sense to have a threshold below zero or above 1 or 100%, and then we can see the score of the model at different thresholds.
cues.zh: 門檻低於 0，或高於 1，也就是 100%，都沒有意義；接著就能看見模型在不同門檻下的分數。

cues.en: And if you look at it, you'll see that the thresholds start very low and the classification score,
cues.zh: 可以看到，門檻一開始很低，而依 PRC 計算的分類分數，

cues.en: according to the PRC, gets higher and higher and it reaches a maximum what seems like close to 100%
cues.zh: 會愈來愈高，最高點似乎接近 100%，

cues.en: in the 80 range and then definitely around the 50% mark, which is often your classification default threshold.
cues.zh: 出現在 80% 左右的區域，而在經常作為預設門檻的 50% 附近，也明顯有高分。

cues.en: But based on visual inspection, we won't be able to tell exactly where the highest park score is.
cues.zh: 但光靠目視，還無法確定最高 PRC 分數究竟在哪裡。

cues.en: So what we can then do is take our data frame and sort the values by the PRC score column and we can
cues.zh: 因此，可以取出 DataFrame，依 PRC 分數欄位排序，

cues.en: set ascending equals false, which sorts it in descending order.
cues.zh: 並設定 ascending=False，以遞減順序排列。

cues.en: So we can see, well, these are the highest scores and these are the thresholds that those highest scores.
cues.zh: 如此就能看到最高分，以及這些最高分所對應的門檻。

cues.en: And interestingly, the highest scores are actually achieved around the 50% mark.
cues.zh: 有意思的是，最高分其實出現在 50% 附近。

cues.en: So this model is quite well calibrated already, which is good news.
cues.zh: 所以，這個模型原本的門檻就已相當合適，這是個好消息。

cues.en: But that isn't always the case, often with highly imbalanced models, especially if you're looking at anomaly detection models, things like auto encoders and isolation forests and other algorithms like
cues.zh: 但不一定每次都是如此；高度不平衡的模型，尤其是自動編碼器、孤立森林等異常偵測

cues.en: that.
cues.zh: 演算法，往往不是這樣。

cues.en: Sometimes you'd need to take a manual approach to thresholding your model.
cues.zh: 有時候，需要手動設定模型的門檻。

cues.en: Then we can also isolate the specific.
cues.zh: 另外，也可以單獨篩選

cues.en: Scores that are above a certain range.
cues.zh: 高於某個範圍的分數，

cues.en: If we want to double check where they lie on the thresholds paradigm.
cues.zh: 再確認它們對應到哪些門檻。

cues.en: And we can see typically that range from around the 45% mark to around the low 50 seconds.
cues.zh: 可以看到，這些門檻通常落在 45% 左右，到 50% 出頭的範圍。
